doc: A (2, 3) field with a (2, 1) float64 threshold column and a (2, 3) subtexel: broadcasting of the column over the columns, smallest 2D case. Pipeline dtypes; tolerance as compose.pipeline_dtypes. Arguments: s, fine, t, streak and subtexel are the inputs of that name when listed; an unlisted t, streak (default 0.0) is the scalar in params, an unlisted subtexel is None; prm holds the GenParams fields compose reads (the others keep their defaults). params.result_dtype ("f64" or "f32") is the dtype numpy gives the result by promotion (a float64 t array or float64 inputs give f64, a python-float t with float32 fields keeps f32); it is informational, the stored output has that dtype. Measured: promoting the float32 inputs to float64 changes the output by at most 1.8e-8; one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 5.9e-8 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is about 2e2x the larger of the two spreads.
